name: rad-brainstorm
description: Text-first brainstorming for one person. It separates idea generation from evaluation and cannot guarantee useful ideas or correct conclusions.

interface.shortDescription: Solo, text-first brainstorming with clear limits.
interface.longDescription: Text-first idea work for one person. It records idea sources, separates generation from evaluation, supports Five Whys and software design, and stops before implementation. It cannot guarantee useful ideas or correct causal claims.
defaultPrompt: Run a quick brainstorm on this topic.
Help me explore this idea without anchoring me on your answers.
Use Five Whys to find the root cause of this problem.
Help me compare these ideas before I choose one.
Turn this chosen software idea into a reviewable design spec.
